research_notes: Project Gutenberg Legge volume 9394 was retrieved for comparison; it does not contain the two required owl poems, so it is not cited as their translator.
Waley corpus printing is not specified by the uploader; 1937 is the work's first-publication year, not a claim about the scan edition.
No modern complete Shanhaijing translation was copied. The other 50 passages are original project renderings of the preserved Chinese, not quotations attributed to Birrell or Strassberg.
Full downloaded third-party books/corpora remain in ignored research caches and are not distributed with the game.
